title: Geospatial Database Architecture & Metro Manila Road Telemetry
goal: Set up PostgreSQL + PostGIS database, schema migrations, Metro Manila arterial road segments, real-time/historical traffic telemetry records, and incident tracking.

issues.title: [Sprint 1] PostgreSQL + PostGIS Containerization & Core Schema Migrations
issues.description: Configure PostgreSQL 15 with PostGIS 3 extension enabled in Docker. Set up Alembic migration environment and implement initial DDL schemas for `road_segments`, `traffic_records`, `incidents`, `predictions`, and `routes` using EPSG:4326 (WGS 84) coordinate reference system as specified in SPEC.md.
acceptance_criteria: PostgreSQL 15 + PostGIS 3 runs reliably via Docker Compose
Alembic or SQL migration scripts cleanly apply and rollback all tables defined in SPEC.md
Spatial GIST indexes created on `road_segments.geometry`, `incidents.geometry`, and `routes.route_geom`
Automated health-check script connects and confirms PostGIS extension version

issues.title: [Sprint 1] Metro Manila Major Arterials Road Network Ingestion
issues.description: Extract, normalize, and ingest GeoJSON LineString geometries for Metro Manila's critical transport corridors (EDSA, C-5 Road, Commonwealth Avenue, Quezon Avenue, Ortigas Avenue, España Boulevard, Roxas Boulevard, and Marcos Highway). Each segment must include direction, city, baseline speed (km/h), and spatial LineString.
acceptance_criteria: Ingestion script processes and stores at least 50 high-priority road segments across Metro Manila
All coordinates strictly validated within Metro Manila bounding box [120.90, 14.35, 121.15, 14.80]
LineString geometries stored with valid SRID 4326
Unit tests verify spatial querying by bounding box and road name

issues.title: [Sprint 1] Traffic Records Telemetry Ingestion Pipeline & Seed Dataset
issues.description: Implement data models and seed generation scripts for `traffic_records` capturing average speed, traffic severity classification (Normal, Moderate, Heavy, Severe), congestion percentage, and observation timestamps. Include historical 7-day pattern data for recurring rush-hour simulations.
acceptance_criteria: `traffic_records` table populated with representative real-world Metro Manila traffic telemetry
Speed classifications strictly match defined thresholds (Normal >= 80%, Moderate 50-79%, Heavy 25-49%, Severe < 25% baseline speed)
Indexes on `(road_segment_id, observed_at DESC)` optimized for fast recent-state queries
Query execution time for current segment status is < 15ms

issues.title: [Sprint 1] Road Incident Tracking Schema & Seed Data Ingestion
issues.description: Implement data models and ingestion for `incidents` table. Populate with realistic Metro Manila road incidents (vehicular accidents, stalled buses/trucks, gutter-deep flooding, road re-blocking/construction) with verified coordinates, reported timestamps, status (Active/Clearing/Resolved), and agency data source attribution.
acceptance_criteria: Incident records store valid Point(lat, lng) geometries within Metro Manila
Includes diverse incident types: ACCIDENT, ROADWORK, FLOOD, STALLED_VEHICLE
Incident statuses accurately reflect lifecycle (REPORTED, ACTIVE, CLEARING, RESOLVED)
PostGIS spatial query test succeeds: finding all incidents within 100m of a given road segment
